title: Mathematical Modeling
summary: Representing selected aspects of a real or imagined system with mathematical structures in order to reason, explain, predict, or support decisions.
definition: Model construction involves defining purpose and scope, selecting variables and assumptions, choosing relationships, estimating parameters, checking consequences against evidence, and revising or rejecting the model when appropriate.
learning_outcomes: Translate a clearly scoped question into variables and relationships.
State assumptions, parameters, units, and validity limits.
Compare model outputs with evidence and revise the representation.
